senses.gloss: f. (פָּקַע) [that which is to be unravelled; cmp. בְּקַעַת] coil, clue of thread, of rope &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 10:4">Kel. X, 4</cite> <he>פ׳ של גמי</he> a coil of rope made of reed grass.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:1">Gen. R. s. 12</cite>, beg. <he>נטל פ׳ של גמי … ונכנס דרך הפ׳ וכ׳</he> he took a clue of rope and tied one end of it to the entrance, and he went in along the unwound rope, and came out along the rope; Koh. R. to II, 12 <he>פְּקִיעַת גמי</he>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>פְּקַעֲיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:2">Kel. XVII, 2</cite> <he>שעורה בפ׳ של שתי</he> is measured by the ordinary size of warp clues.
<cite ref="Chagigah 12a:15">Ḥag. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>היה מרחיב והולך כשתי פ׳ וכ׳</he> was extending farther and farther (in two directions) like two unwound clues &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:3">Gen. R. s. 10</cite>, beg. <he>נטל הקב״ה שתי פ׳ וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="Q01491"><he>פקיעיות</he></cite>, corr. acc.) the Lord took two coils, one of snow and one of fire, and worked them into each other.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 119b:7">B. Kam. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>שירי פ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>שיורי פְּקִיעוֹת</he>; Ms. R. 2 <he>פְּקָעוֹת</he>) remnants of coils (given to the weaver); a. e.
